name: Piacentine
license: Public Domain — pip cards (28) synthesized at build time by compositing N copies of the PD Suit_{Bastoni,Coppe,Denari,Spade}.svg icons from https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Piacenza_deck onto a card-shaped canvas; face cards (12) sliced from the PD Carte_piacentine_al_completo.jpg in the same Commons category. Synthesis preserves the exact pip artwork the original PD Piacentine-{C,D,S}*.svg files use, so all pip cards share one consistent visual style. The card back is a synthetic ornamental design (no PD Piacentine back exists on Commons).
